title: Allergy skin tests
what: Drops of allergen solutions are placed on the skin of your forearm or back, and the skin is lightly scratched. After 15 to 20 minutes, the doctor checks where redness and bumps appear.
why: For hay fever, rashes, asthma, or reactions to food or insect stings, to find out exactly what you are allergic to.
duration: usually 30 to 60 minutes with waiting; results right away
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially allergy pills, steroids, and blood pressure pills
If you ever had a severe allergic reaction or swelling
If your allergy or asthma is flaring up now
Any skin conditions on your arms or back

prepare.title: Allergy medicines
prepare.text: They can hide the result. Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor. They will decide what to stop and how many days before.

prepare.title: Health
prepare.text: Tests are usually done when allergies are not flaring. If you have strong allergy symptoms or a cold now, they are postponed.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: On the test day, do not put cream on your arms or back.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Wear a sleeve that is easy to pull up, or clothes that let you show your back.

bring: Notes on past reactions and allergy tests
steps: The doctor decides which allergens to test
The skin is wiped and marked with a pen
A drop of allergen goes on each mark
Through the drop, the skin is lightly scratched or pricked with a single-use lancet
You wait 15 to 20 minutes without touching the skin
The doctor measures the bumps and writes down the results
feel: Where there is a reaction: itching, redness, and a bump like a mosquito bite
after: The itching and bumps usually go away in a few hours
The doctor explains the results right away
red_flags: Swelling of the face or lips, trouble breathing, or strong weakness after the tests: call emergency services
A strong rash all over the body: see a doctor right away

faq.a: Yes, usually from a few years of age. The allergist decides the age and method.

faq.q: Why should I not take allergy pills before?
faq.a: They block the skin reaction, so the tests may show nothing. Your doctor will tell you how many days before to stop them.

reminders.text: Allergy skin tests in 3 days. Ask your doctor if you should stop allergy pills ahead of time. Do not stop them on your own.
